comment: Inputs for scripts/generate-images.js. Each task produces a single 1024x1024 jpg under public/images/testimonials/<id>.jpg. Run optimize:images after to add avif + webp.
stylePrefix: Editorial natural-light headshot. East-Asian subject. Soft window light from the side. Muted low-contrast palette in cream / warm grey / soft sage. Subtle film grain. Calm composition, eye-level. No logos, no brand names, no text. Square 1:1 framing with the face roughly centred, shoulders visible.

tasks.prompt: Young Asian woman in her early thirties, fair clean skin with a hint of sensitivity-redness near the cheeks, no makeup, sitting on a soft beige sofa in a sunlit living room. Wearing a relaxed off-white linen shirt. Hair tied loosely back. Looking softly toward the camera with a gentle, calm expression. Morning light from a side window.

Asian man in his mid-thirties, athletic build, just-back-from-running look — slightly damp hair, plain charcoal heather grey T-shirt, towel draped over his shoulder. Standing near a wooden entryway with running shoes in soft focus behind him. Genuine, easy half-smile. Natural skin texture, no retouching.

Asian mother in her early thirties, soft features, holding a folded muslin baby blanket close to her chest. Wearing a loose oatmeal-coloured cardigan. Standing in a softly lit nursery, gentle morning light through sheer curtains. Tender, tired-but-content expression. No baby visible — just the suggestion of motherhood through the cloth.

Asian man in his seventies, kind weathered face with fine wrinkles, short silver hair. Wearing a soft mushroom-grey collared shirt. Sitting near a window with potted plants. Soft afternoon light. Calm, slightly amused expression — the look of someone who has stopped worrying about small things. Sharp focus on the eyes.

Asian woman in her early twenties, fresh face with a few visible acne marks healing, no foundation, hair in a loose ponytail. Wearing a plain white tee. Sitting cross-legged on a wooden floor with a textbook beside her, sunlit dorm-room feel. Honest, unposed expression. Soft overcast daylight from above.

Asian man in his early forties, business-casual look — fine navy knit over a white shirt, no tie. Standing in a softly lit office with a wooden desk visible behind him. Composed, approachable expression. Confident but warm. Light from a high window, slight bokeh on background bookshelves.

Asian woman in her early thirties, well-groomed without being made-up, holding a small handmade soap on a linen cloth in her open palm. Wearing a soft sage-green smock. Indoor studio with paper backdrop in warm off-white. Curious, analytical expression — someone who reviews products thoughtfully. Even softbox lighting.

Asian woman in her early fifties, soft features with natural age signs, short bobbed hair with a few silver strands. Wearing a quiet dusty-pink linen top. Sitting at a low wooden table with a ceramic teacup nearby. Soft side light, late-afternoon golden hour. Warm, settled expression — the look of someone who has come through something.
